component.name: Filen
component.summary: Next generation end-to-end encrypted cloud storage

description.p: Filen provides zero-knowledge end-to-end encrypted cloud storage, file synchronization, and backup solutions designed for ultimate privacy and security.

ul.li: Client-side zero-knowledge end-to-end encryption for all files and metadata
Two-way and one-way file synchronization with custom local directories
Local virtual drive, WebDAV, and S3 local endpoint integration powered by rclone
Custom sync intervals and selective synchronization
Automatic camera upload and background syncing
Version history and file restoration capabilities

description.p: Filen Desktop 3.0.53 release with enhanced sync reliability, updated rclone engine, and performance optimizations.
Maintenance release with stability improvements and bug fixes.
